You probably believe this: YOU'RE LAZY AFTER 3PM. But that's not the full story.

Every decision drains the same fuel tank. By evening, your brain picks whatever's easiest. Here's what's happening: Judges grant parole about 65% at the start of sessions and near 0% before breaks. Not cruel, depleted.
Danziger and colleagues, in 2011,, PNAS: favorable rulings peaked at session start and dropped to near-zero before food breaks.
